support.title: Support
support.subtitle: Questions, suggestions, and technical help.
support.emailDesc: We usually reply within a few business days.
support.faqAccountA: No. Your progress and library are stored only on your device.
support.faqOfflineA: Yes. Text is bundled in the app and reads offline. Cover images download on first open and stay cached. Source links need a connection.
support.faqDataA: It is not sent to our servers. Deleting the app removes data on your device.

legal.localStorageInfo: Your data (progress, saved items) is stored only on this device and is not sent to our servers.
legal.privacyIntro: True Frame is built with privacy in mind. No account is required.
legal.privacyStorageBody: Your reading progress, saved items, and completed journeys are stored only in local storage on your device. This data is not transmitted to our servers and is removed when you delete the app.
legal.privacyContactBody: Emails sent via feedback are used only to respond to you and improve the application.
legal.privacyLinksBody: Source links may direct you to third-party websites. True Frame is not responsible for their privacy practices.
legal.termsContentBody: True Frame is an educational app exploring connections between popular culture and historical facts. Content is based on reliable sources but should not be used as an academic reference.
legal.termsUsageBody: You may use app content for personal, non-commercial purposes. Copying or unauthorized sharing on other platforms is prohibited.
legal.termsDisclaimerBody: The app is provided "as is". Technical updates or content revisions may occur from time to time.

settings.title: Settings
settings.aboutDesc: An educational app to discover the real history behind games, films, and series, with source-backed deep reads instead of quick notes.
settings.contentSourcesBody: Card text is based on reliable sources and reviewed periodically. Each card includes source links. The app does not claim official affiliation with any media property.
settings.disclaimerBody: This app is for education and exploration; it is not an academic reference. Historical interpretations may be updated over time.
